map.按发育阶段选方法：胎儿用股骨长/顶臀长推算胎龄；婴幼儿用腕骨出现数（≈腕骨数+1: Pick the method by developmental stage: for a fetus use the femoral length / head-to-heel length to estimate gestational age; for infants combine the number of carpal bones (about the count + 1 year) with the appearance of the metacarpal and phalangeal epiphyses; for adolescents and adults compare the epiphyseal fusion stage and the morphology of the pubic symphysis against the standards to infer the age range. ...
